task.title: Determining if the client qualifies for benefits on a new claim

step.cmd: Determine if all the information is on file to establish whether the client qualifies for benefits on a new claim (e.g. an application, all ROEs):
Contact the client for fact finding :

ul.li: Ask if the client intends to apply for a new claim.
Obtain from the client the missing information required to determine if the client qualifies for benefits on a new claim.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If client was contacted, go to step 12.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Benefit period (BP) not terminated . Benefit period (BP) not terminated

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Determine if the required information was obtained:
Determine if the client indicated that the required information will be submitted:

ul.li: If no, go to Benefit period (BP) not terminated . Benefit period (BP) not terminated

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Waiting for the client to submit information.”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if the required information has been received:

ul.li: If no, go to Benefit period (BP) not terminated . Benefit period (BP) not terminated

step.cmd: Determine if the client qualifies to establish a new BP (refer to the applicable Calculating or recalculating a claim activity):

ul.li: If no, go to Benefit period (BP) not terminated . Benefit period (BP) not terminated
